records.name: 29, RUTLAND STREET
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies 29 Rutland Street as a dated 1875 warehouse, four storeys, buff-coloured brick with stone dressings and a slate hipped roof.

records.name: 7, UPPER KING STREET
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies 7 Upper King Street as an early-C19 house, two storeys and attic, with later mansard roof and stuccoed front.

records.name: 98-104, NEW WALK
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies 98-104 New Walk as an early-C19 terrace in grey gault brick and stucco dressings, two storeys with a later attic storey.
